description: Implementation of TaxClassService, managing tax class entities, interacting with the DAO layer, and providing methods to retrieve and delete tax classes per store or by code.

classes.name: TaxClassServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing TaxClass entities, extending generic service and implementing TaxClassService interface.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves list of TaxClass objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass object by its code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass object by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its ID.
